newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Eindhoven airport's cargo volumes up 13.6 in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Eindhoven airport's cargo volumes up 13.6 in Q1.

text.p: Eindhoven Airport has seen its freight volumes for the first quarter of the year increase by more than 13 percent, an airport statement said.
In the first three months, the southern Dutch airport experienced a 13.6 percent rise to 5,862 tonnes this year from 5,160 tonnes in the first quarter of 1996.
However, only 86 tonnes were actually flown during the first quarter. The remainder was trucked cargo, the statement added.

Scheduled trucking services leave the Dutch airport on a daily basis to eight European airports - Amsterdam, Brussels, Cologne, Frankfurt, Paris Charles de Gaulle, Paris Orly, London Gatwick and London Heathrow.

Passenger traffic did not experience any increase in the first three months. A total of 52,289 passengers used the airport or 0.6 percent less than in the same period the year previously. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
